component.name: NectarLink
component.summary: Connect your Android phone and Linux PC over LAN

description.p: NectarLink links your Android phone and Linux desktop over your local network with end-to-end encryption.

ul.li: Sync clipboard text and images bidirectionally
Mirror phone notifications and reply inline from your desktop
Send and receive files, folders, and browsable phone storage via SFTP
Stream phone screen, camera, and audio with low latency
Read and send SMS/MMS messages and manage phone calls
